clusters.mechanism: Credential overlap removal after a truncated tail assumes ANSI sequences are fully stripped, but a cut inside an escape sequence leaves its formatting suffix, which consumes the overlap and leaves credential bytes.
Whole-state redactGateData in the RunContext constructor rewrites operational state (phase, baselineScripts), replacing short credentials and stripping ANSI, so resumed runs misbehave.
Coverage parsing resolves paths with realpath after the line was redacted, so a credential in the canonical filename enters testCoverage unredacted.
Failure excerpts are redacted line by line, so a registered credential containing a newline never matches and leaks in the failures field.
The artifact endpoint parses and re-serializes artifacts and strips control characters, so served bytes no longer match the stored content (minified JSON, altered patches, added fields).
Prompt builders run their inputs through redactGateData, which strips terminal escape sequences from the patch and other inputs, so the reviewer sees altered content.

Lossy JSON-roundtrip redactGateData is applied at many consumers (HTTP/SSE, state, cache, report), going beyond the single-point, ~30-line scope and altering shapes and adding confinementError to any ok/output object.
confinementError is now always serialized as false, dropping the 'present only when set' compatibility convention, and an explicit false skips the output scan in confinementFailed.
